name: Security review
purpose: Review changes for security-sensitive behavior and explicit permission boundaries.
trigger: A change affects authentication, authorization, secrets, dependencies, data, or tools.
prerequisites: The changed trust boundaries are identified.

steps.action: Trace untrusted inputs, privileged operations, and sensitive data.
Verify least privilege and make any permission change visible.
Record scan results and manual findings; distinguish checks not run.
Request explicit approval for a sensitive permission change.

approvals.reason: Sensitive permission changes require explicit owner approval.

recovery: Stop and block on a suspected credential leak or privilege escalation.
Do not dismiss a finding without recording the evidence and rationale.
